lines.en: label utaspring9:
scene utaleak1
: Did I...fall asleep?
lines.zh: : 我……睡着了吗？

lines.en: scene ayanetss2
: Ayane, what are you doing? You’ve been staring at that naked notebook for like five minutes now.
lines.zh: : Ayane，你在干什么？你盯着那个光溜溜的笔记本盯了得有五分钟了。

lines.en: : Please just call it {i}blank,{/i} Ami. We gain literally nothing from personifying inanimate objects like that.
lines.zh: : 请叫它{i}空白{/i}笔记本就好，Ami。把没有生命的东西拟人化，我们什么好处都捞不着。

lines.en: scene ayanetss3
: Well, whatever the case is, I’m worried!
lines.zh: : 好吧，不管怎样，我很担心！

lines.en: : Ayane’s supposed to be the bubbly, happy one! {i}I’m{/i} supposed to be the one doing mildly unsettling things and making everybody uncomfortable!
lines.zh: : Ayane 本该是那个活泼开朗的！{i}我{/i}才是该做些让人微微不适的事、把大家弄得尴尬的那个！

lines.en: : I’m glad to see that you’ve finally embraced it. What’s my role?
lines.zh: : 很高兴看到你终于接受这一点了。那我扮演什么角色？

lines.en: scene ayanetss4
: I don’t know. Something sexual.
lines.zh: : 不知道。某种色色的角色。

lines.en: : Nice.
lines.zh: : 不错。

lines.en: scene utaleak2
: Oh. Uhh...I was just finishing yesterday’s homework and...
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……我刚把昨天的作业写完，然后……

lines.en: : Sorry, did anything really weird just happen to anybody else? I feel like I just came back from another dimension again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，有没有别人也刚好发生了什么很奇怪的事？我感觉自己又从另一个维度回来了。

lines.en: : Again? Is that something you do often?
lines.zh: : 又？你经常这样吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Ami. How about you?
lines.zh: : 是啊，Ami。你呢？

lines.en: : Whatever do you mean, best friend?
lines.zh: : 你是什么意思呢，最好的朋友？

lines.en: scene utaleak3
: I don’t know. What {i}do{/i} I mean, best friend?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我{i}是{/i}什么意思呢，最好的朋友？

lines.en: : Can you two stop bickering and just kiss already?
lines.zh: : 你们俩能不能别吵了，直接亲上去算了？

lines.en: : We already have. And let the record show that Ayane was the aggressor which means she’s gayer than me.
lines.zh: : 我们已经亲过了。而且在此声明，是 Ayane 主动的，也就是说她比我更弯。

lines.en: : Ahh...youth. Can you smell that, Io?
lines.zh: : 啊……青春啊。你闻到了吗，Io？

lines.en: : No, why? Did you buy another new perfume that I’m supposed to notice?
lines.zh: : 没有，怎么了？你又买了新香水，希望我注意到？

lines.en: scene utaleak4

: No, the smell of {i}love!{/i} Girls with boys. Boys with girls. Girls with girls and boys with boys and sometimes two girls with one boy when your name is Io and you believe in throuples! Isn’t it just intoxicating?!
lines.zh: : 不是，是恋{i}爱{/i}的味道！女孩配男孩。男孩配女孩。女孩配女孩、男孩配男孩，有时候两个女孩配一个男孩——当你的名字叫 Io、而且你相信三人行的时候！是不是醉人极了？！

lines.en: : Not really. Also, are you hallucinating boys? Because we only know one of those and it would make sense if you suddenly decided to make a bunch of them up to increase your chances or fuel further fantasies.
lines.zh: : 不怎么觉得。还有，你是在产生男孩的幻觉吗？因为我们只认识一个男孩，如果你突然决定凭空编出一堆来，好增加自己的机会、或者给进一步的幻想添柴，那倒是说得通。

lines.en: scene utaleak5
: What do you mean {i}another{/i} perfume? Do I buy them that often?
lines.zh: : 又买了{i}新{/i}香水是什么意思？我买得有那么勤吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but I assume it’s just your form of retail therapy, which isn’t all that harmful in small doses. It’s like me with different size screws. Just way more expensive and a lot less useful.
lines.zh: : 有，不过我猜那只是你的购物疗法，小剂量的话倒也没什么害处。就像我买各种尺寸的螺丝一样。只是贵得多，也没那么有用。

lines.en: : Never underestimate how useful perfume can be when applied to the right situations, Io.
lines.zh: : 别小看香水用对场合时能有多管用，Io。

lines.en: : Did you read that in a magazine?
lines.zh: : 你是在杂志上看来的吧？

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Well, is it too late to cancel your subscription? Because your strategy clearly isn’t working based on the fact that you are in the very exclusive club of girls in 1-A who have not yet experienced any form of sexual contact.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}那么，现在取消你的订阅还来得及吗？因为你的策略显然没奏效——毕竟你正身处 1-A 班里那个极其小众的 club：至今没有任何形式性接触的女生。{/size}

lines.en: scene utaleak6
: I’m just waiting for the right moment.
lines.zh: : 我只是在等一个对的时机。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, is there a wrong one?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇问一下，还有错的时机吗？

lines.en: : Duh. Like, funerals? No good.
lines.zh: : 废话。比如，葬礼？不行。

lines.en: : Is that the only one? I figured you would list more.
lines.zh: : 就这一个吗？我还以为你能列出更多。

lines.en: scene utaleak7
: I was about to say hatsumode but then I changed my mind because I think it would be hot to do it in a yukata.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说新年参拜的，不过我改主意了，因为我觉得穿着浴衣做会很带感。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think you might need a little more counseling.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得你可能需要再多来点心理咨询。

lines.en: : Maybe a yukata might actually be the trick to make Sensei finally notice me?
lines.zh: : 也许浴衣真的就是让 Sensei 终于注意到我的诀窍？

lines.en: : All this time, I’ve figured the maid costume would do him in. But I’m worried he may have started seeing me as some sort of god and not just a curious, flirty girl anymore.
lines.zh: : 一直以来，我都以为女仆装能把他拿下。可我担心他可能已经开始把我当成某种神明了，而不再只是一个好奇又爱撩的女孩。

lines.en: scene utaleak8

: Regardless! It’s spring! Which means that love is in the air and that it’s time for me to once again start plotting out how to get Sensei’s attention at the beach! Also also how I will cope when I ultimately back down!
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！春天了！也就是说空气里都是恋爱的味道，我又该开始盘算怎么在海滩上吸引 Sensei 的注意力了！还有，等我最终怂了之后要怎么自我疏导！

lines.en: : I’d say to just be yourself, but I think that’s exactly why you’re in this predicament in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我本想说做你自己就好，不过我觉得那恰恰就是你落到这步田地的原因。

lines.en: scene utaleak9
: How about some sort of calculated wardrobe malfunction? I’ll keep the string of my bathing suit loose, you can bump into me while I’m talking to Sensei, then boom!
lines.zh: : 那来个精心设计的走光怎么样？我把泳衣的系带留松一点，我在跟 Sensei 说话的时候你撞我一下，然后砰！

lines.en: : The ladies say hi, I cover ‘em up and run off all {i}embarrassed,{/i} then he chases me down and comforts me before his lust gets the better of him and I wind up all sweaty and tied to a bike rack.
lines.zh: : 两位女士打声招呼，我捂住它们{i}羞涩{/i}地跑开，然后他追上来安慰我，接着他的欲火占了上风，最后我一身汗地被绑在自行车架上。

lines.en: : What if somebody needs to get their bike?
lines.zh: : 那要是有人要取车怎么办？

lines.en: scene utaleak10
: Well, they’ll obviously just have to wait! Hold on, does the inn even have a bike rack?
lines.zh: : 那他们显然就得等着！等等，那旅馆到底有没有自行车架？

lines.en: : It’s kind of a little too far out there to bike to, isn’t it? Oh well! Like, I’m not saying it needs to be a bike rack {i}specifically.{/i} Pretty much anything within reach will do.
lines.zh: : 那儿骑车过去有点太远了吧？唉算了！就是说，我也没说{i}非得{/i}是自行车架。够得着的东西基本都行。

lines.en: scene utaleak11
: A bike rack’s just the first thing that came to mind but, either way, this is all just an idea!
lines.zh: : 自行车架只是我第一个想到的，不过不管怎样，这些都只是个想法！

lines.en: : Like, I obviously need {i}some{/i} sort of push since I’ve been completely incapable of getting him to touch me on my own. But if {i}unintentionally{/i} forcing me to go topless is a little much for you, I-
lines.zh: : 就是说，我显然需要{i}某种{/i}推力，因为我靠自己根本没法让他碰我。不过如果{i}无意间{/i}害我走光对你来说太过分了，我——

lines.en: : Io?
lines.zh: : Io？

lines.en: scene utaleak12
: Something wrong? You get a text?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了？收到短信了？

lines.en: scene utaleak13
: Sorry, it’s nothing. What were you saying?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，没什么。你刚说到哪儿了？

lines.en: : Just...more stuff about battle plans and how to take the next step in my transition from girlhood to womanhood.
lines.zh: : 就是……更多关于作战计划的事，以及我该怎么迈出从女孩变成女人的下一步。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t want to help you flash Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我可不想帮你对着 Sensei 走光。

lines.en: scene utaleak14
: Then we will think of something else! That was just a spur-of-the-moment idea anyway. And I-
lines.zh: : 那我们再想别的！反正那也是一时兴起的点子。而且我——

lines.en: scene utaleak15
: AHHHHH WHAT THE FRICK IS THAT?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊这他妈是什么鬼东西？！？！？！

lines.en: scene utaleak16
: Miku! Keep it down over there. Any louder and you’re going to scare yourself.
lines.zh: : Miku！那边小声点。再大声点你就把自己吓着了。

lines.en: : Sorry, Miss Imai. But either some girl just accidentally sent me her nudes or I got myself a secret admirer I ain’t even remotely interested in...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Imai 老师。不过要么是哪个女生不小心把她的裸照发给我了，要么是我有了个我一点都不感兴趣的暗恋者……

lines.en: scene utaleak17
: Someone...sent {i}you{/i} nudes? Of all people?
lines.zh: : 有人给{i}你{/i}发裸照？在所有人里？

lines.en: : {i}Of all people?!{/i} The heck is that supposed to mean?! Maki says all sorts’a girls are desirable and I was definitely a girl last time I checked!
lines.zh: : 在{i}所有人{/i}里？！ 这他妈是什么意思？！Maki 说什么样的女生都有人要，而且我上次检查的时候绝对是个女生！

lines.en: scene utaleak18
: {i}Uta, can you come to the nurse’s office with me? I think I forgot one of my medications in there.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta，你能陪我去一趟保健室吗？我好像把一种药落在那儿了。{/i}

lines.en: scene utaleak19
: I don’t mean anything {i}bad{/i} by that. There are plenty of people out there with...Miku-like preferences. I’m just surprised that it’s you and not someone like-
lines.zh: : 我那话没有{i}恶意{/i}。外面有很多人有着……Miku 那样的偏好。我只是惊讶居然是你，而不是像——

lines.en: scene utaleak20
: Oh my God.
lines.zh: : 我的天。

lines.en: : Exactly! Someone like Futaba. That makes more sense.
lines.zh: : 就是啊！比如 Futaba 那样的人，才更说得通。

lines.en: : Futaba, your friggin’ boobs keep causin’ me problems even when they ain’t directly involved! Put those things away already!
lines.zh: : Futaba，你那该死的奶子就算没直接出场也一直在给我找麻烦！赶紧把那两样东西收起来吧！

lines.en: : Uta...{i}now?{/i}
lines.zh: : Uta……{i}现在{/i}？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, I just...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是……

lines.en: scene utaleak21
: Just gonna...{i}delete that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我这就……把它{i}删了{/i}。

lines.en: scene utaleak22
: Okay, okay. So there’s some sorta inappropriate photo going around. But ain’t y’all ever seen a naked girl before? Just ignore it like it’s one of those chain messages and move on.
lines.zh: : 好了好了。所以是有某种不雅照片在到处传。可你们以前都没见过裸女吗？就当它是那种连锁短信，忽略掉然后翻篇不就行了。

lines.en: : M...Miss Imai is right. It’s just- ah!
lines.zh: : I……Imai 老师说得对。只是——啊！

lines.en: : What’re you squeaking about over there, huh?
lines.zh: : 你那边又在吱哇叫什么，嗯？

lines.en: : I tried to delete it, but...it’s back and...ah! I just got...five more?!
lines.zh: : 我想删掉的，可是……它又回来了，而且……啊！我又收到了……五张？！

lines.en: scene utaleak23
: And I- HOLY HECK! SO DID I! GET A FRIGGIN’ GRIP, GIRL! I AIN’T INTERESTED!
lines.zh: : 而且我——我靠！我也收到了！你他妈冷静点，姑娘！我没兴趣！

lines.en: : Have you tried texting back “STOP?” Could be some sort of robo-marketing thing for that store Makoto’s family definitely doesn’t run.
lines.zh: : 你们试过回短信“退订”吗？说不定是某种机器人营销，替那家 Makoto 家肯定没开的店发的。

lines.en: : I think we’d know if that was the case!
lines.zh: : 我觉得要是那样我们早该知道了！

lines.en: : Don’t just openly admit it! That’s supposed to be a secret!
lines.zh: : 别这么大嘴巴承认啊！那本来该是秘密的！

lines.en: : This reminds me once more of the corrupted blood incident. There’s naught we can do to quell the spread of the virus. Which means that this is, unfortunately, where we all die.
lines.zh: : 这让我想起了又一次的腐化之血事件。我们无力遏制病毒的扩散。也就是说，很不幸，这里就是我们全体的葬身之地。

lines.en: : I too have received these photographs. I am officially popular.
lines.zh: : 我也收到了这些照片。我正式地受欢迎了。

lines.en: : Just turn your damn phones off if it’s gonna be such a distraction. Y’all are getting even louder than normal and I don’t want Wakana coming in here and yelling at me again. Understo-
lines.zh: : 要是这么分心，就把你们那该死的手机关了。你们比平时还吵，我可不想 Wakana 再冲进来冲我吼。明白——

lines.en: : AHHHHH NO! GET THAT THING AWAY FROM ME, SANA! THIS IS A TOTAL INVASION OF...{i}SOMEBODY’S PRIVACY!{/i} PROBABLY!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊不要！把那玩意儿拿开，SANA！这完全是在侵犯……{i}某个人的隐私{/i}！ 大概吧！

lines.en: : I thought it was Miku for a second...
lines.zh: : 我有一瞬间还以为是 Miku……

lines.en: : Oh, real nice, Sana! Real nice! You ain’t all the impressive either!
lines.zh: : 哦，真好啊，Sana！真好！你也没什么了不起的！

lines.en: scene utaleak24
: That is...an entire vagina.
lines.zh: : 那是……一整个阴部。

lines.en: : Let me see, let me see! I like vaginas! I like-
lines.zh: : 让我看看，让我看看！我喜欢阴部！我喜欢——

lines.en: scene utaleak25
: Oh, jeez. Not that kind of vagina. I’m not trying to get put on a list.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪。不是那种阴部。我可不想被拉进什么名单里。

lines.en: : I’m just glad it’s not my sister. All I got was a closeup of a chest at first and thought I was being extorted.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴那不是我妹妹。我一开始只收到一张胸部的特写，还以为自己被敲诈了。

lines.en: : It looks kind of like Uta if anybody, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 要说像谁的话，倒有点像 Uta，不是吗？

lines.en: scene utaleak26
: I don’t see Miku at all. And that’s coming from a place of great experience since I have seen her naked many, many times.
lines.zh: : 我一点都看不出 Miku。这可是出于丰富的经验——因为我见过她裸体的样子好多次、好多次了。

lines.en: : Huh...Yeah, I can kind of see that. The hair definitely matches in some of the other pictures. Was Uta ever a tomboy, though?
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊，我倒也能看出点来。其他几张里发型确实对得上。不过 Uta 以前当过假小子吗？

lines.en: : There are a few with school uniforms but I don’t recognize any of the colors, so it’s not Kumon-mi. Where’s Uta from again?
lines.zh: : 有几张是穿校服的，可我认不出那些颜色，所以不是 Kumon-mi。Uta 老家是哪儿来着？

lines.en: : Nara, but it’s obviously not her. Uta’s too sweet to ever take pictures {i}this{/i} raunchy.
lines.zh: : 奈良，不过那显然不是她。Uta 太乖了，不可能拍{i}这么{/i}下流的照片。

lines.en: : She seems kind of quiet all of a sudden though, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 不过她突然变得挺安静的，不是吗？

lines.en: scene utaleak27
: Imani-
lines.zh: : Imani——

lines.en: : I know, I know. I was just about to confiscate everyone’s phones and duct tape all their mouths shut. Sorry for all the noise.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。我正准备没收所有人的手机，再用胶带把她们的嘴全封上。抱歉这么吵。

lines.en: : It’s happening here too then?
lines.zh: : 你们这儿也在发生这事？

lines.en: scene utaleak28
: Wait, {i}too?{/i} Your kids are gettin’ this weird chain message thingy as well? Think the school messenger app might’ve gotten hacked or something?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}也{/i}？你们班的孩子也收到了这个奇怪的连锁短信？觉得是学校的短信 app 被黑了还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I have no clue, but-
lines.zh: : 我完全没头绪，不过——

lines.en: scene utaleak29
: Guys! Have you already heard about the-
lines.zh: : 各位！你们已经听说了——

lines.en: : We know. Go away.
lines.zh: : 我们知道了。走吧。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: scene utaleak28
: What do we even do for things like this? The teacher’s handbook didn’t say shit about nudie epidemics.
lines.zh: : 这种事我们到底该怎么办？教师手册里可没写怎么处理裸照疫情。

lines.en: : SANA, STOP! SERIOUSLY! I DON’T WANT TO SEE!
lines.zh: : SANA，住手！说真的！我不想看！

lines.en: scene utaleak30
: Why are you so afraid of girls all of a sudden?...You’re not afraid of me too now, are you?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么突然这么怕女生了？……你现在连我也怕了吗？……

lines.en: : Go show Nodoka then! She’s just sitting there!
lines.zh: : 那去给 Nodoka 看啊！她就坐在那儿！

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, that’s a Nara uniform. I just looked it up.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊，那是奈良的校服。我刚查过了。{/i}

lines.en: : That still doesn’t mean anything.
lines.zh: : 那也说明不了什么。

lines.en: : Yeah, there’s no way of knowing if-
lines.zh: : 是啊，没法知道是不是——

lines.en: scene utaleak31
: {size=+20}{b}CAN YOU ALL JUST FUCKING SHUT UP ALREADY?!{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=+20}{b}你们他妈能不能全都给我闭嘴？！{/b}{/size}

lines.en: : {size=-5}DAY IN AND DAY OUT, EVERY SINGLE ONE OF YOU RANTS AND RAVES ABOUT SEX AND NOW YOU’RE GOING TO SIT THERE AND MAKE A BIG DEAL OUT OF SOMEBODY’S PRIVATE PHOTOS LIKE YOU’VE NEVER SEEN A FUCKING NAKED BODY BEFORE?!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-5}日复一日，你们每一个人都在喋喋不休地讲性讲性，现在倒好，有人几张私密照片，你们就坐在那儿大惊小怪，搞得像从没见过他妈的裸体一样？！{/size}

lines.en: : JUST SHUT UP! NOBODY GIVES A SHIT! IT’S A {i}PICTURE!{/i} AND NONE OF YOU WOULD FUCKING CARE AT ALL IF YOU WEREN’T ALREADY SO FUCKING OBSESSED WITH ALL OF THIS NONSENSE!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴吧！没人在乎！那只是一张{i}照片{/i}！ 要不是你们早就对这堆狗屁事情痴迷到不行，你们他妈根本一点都不会在乎！

lines.en: : DELETE THE PICTURES. BLOCK THE NUMBER. TURN YOUR PHONES OFF. IT’S THAT FUCKING EASY!
lines.zh: : 删掉照片。拉黑号码。关掉手机。就他妈这么简单！

lines.en: : THIS IS A FUCKING {i}SCHOOL!{/i} NOT A SEX CLUB! READ A FUCKING BOOK OR SOMETHING!
lines.zh: : 这里是他妈的{i}学校{/i}！ 不是性爱俱乐部！去他妈看本书什么的！

lines.en: scene utaleak32
: Io’s right. Everybody, bring your phones to the front of the room. We’ll keep them in the office until the end of the day while we figure out what to do about this.
lines.zh: : Io 说得对。各位，把手机交到教室前面来。我们会把它们保管在办公室里，直到今天放学、我们想出怎么处理这件事为止。

lines.en: : Sh...Shouldn’t we contact the police? The girl in those photos is...um...well...
lines.zh: : 那……我们不该报警吗？照片里的那个女孩是……嗯……那个……

lines.en: : The {i}police{/i} aren’t going to fucking do anything! They’ll just tell you the same fucking thing I did!
lines.zh: : {i}警察{/i}他妈什么都不会做的！他们只会跟你说跟我一模一样的话！

lines.en: : But they could at least trace the number or-
lines.zh: : 可他们至少能追踪号码或者——

lines.en: : You think someone who would mass text that disgusting crap to an entire class wouldn’t also take measures to hide their trail?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得一个会把那种恶心的玩意儿群发给全班的人，不会同时采取措施隐藏自己的踪迹吗？！

lines.en: : You think the police will look at those photos and {i}find the culprit?!{/i} How fucking annoyingly optimistic does a person have to be to-
lines.zh: : 你觉得警察看了那些照片就能{i}找出犯人{/i}？！ 一个人得他妈乐观到多烦人的程度才会——

lines.en: : Io, thank you. I can handle it. Everyone, bring your phones up here now. Not optional. Sorry.
lines.zh: : Io，谢了。我能处理。各位，现在把手机交上来。不是可选项。抱歉。

lines.en: : Ushibori, while I’m here, you left your bow outside after morning practice today. Come with me and I’ll unlock the equipment room for you.
lines.zh: : Ushibori，既然我在这儿——你今天晨练之后把弓落在外面了。跟我来，我去给你开器材室的门。

lines.en: : {i}Go. Get out here. That’s your-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}走。出去。那是你的——{/i}

lines.en: : It’s fine, Io.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Io。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
scene utaleak33
: I said it’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我说没事的。

lines.en: : They’ve already figured it out.
lines.zh: : 她们已经搞明白了。

lines.en: scene utaleak34
: {i}Uta! Don’t!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Uta！别！{/i}

lines.en: : Why, though?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？

lines.en: scene utaleak35
: These are my friends.
lines.zh: : 她们是我的朋友。

lines.en: : I shouldn’t have to hide who I am from them.
lines.zh: : 我不该对她们隐瞒自己是什么样的人。

lines.en: : They won’t care how many lonely men all over the globe have jerked off to my pictures. Or how many cum tributes were sent back to me.
lines.zh: : 她们不会在乎全世界有多少寂寞的男人对着我的照片打过飞机。也不会在乎有多少人把精液当贡品寄回给我。

lines.en: : They won’t care how happy I was to take those photos. Or how happy I was sending them. Or how happy I am right now, knowing that some of them won’t actually delete them either.
lines.zh: : 她们不会在乎我拍那些照片的时候有多开心。也不会在乎我发出去的时候有多开心。更不会在乎我现在有多开心——因为我知道她们中有一些人其实也不会真的删掉。

lines.en: : It brings me great joy knowing how many people I can make happy with my body. And that it doesn’t matter what shape, size, or age it is in order to do that.
lines.zh: : 知道自己能用这副身体让多少人开心，给我带来极大的快乐。而且不管它是什么形状、什么尺寸、什么年纪，都无所谓。

lines.en: : None of us can help what we like at the end of the day. And for me, that just happens to be this.
lines.zh: : 说到底，我们都管不住自己喜欢什么。而对我来说，恰好就是这个。

lines.en: : I don’t mind it at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不介意。

lines.en: : I don’t mind it at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不介意。

lines.en: scene black
: I don’t mind it at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不介意。

lines.en: scene utaleak36
: Ami? What are you doing back so early? School doesn’t end for another four hours.
lines.zh: : Ami？你怎么这么早就回来了？还有四个小时才放学呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, we all got sent home early. New question, though — have you gotten any weird pictures sent to your phone today?
lines.zh: : 是啊，我们都被提前赶回家了。不过问个新问题——你今天手机上收到什么奇怪的照片了吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...no. Why?
lines.zh: : 呃……没有。怎么了？

lines.en: : Are you telling the truth or are you lying to me right now because you don’t want to feel bad about keeping them?
lines.zh: : 你说的是真话，还是现在在骗我，因为你留着那些照片不想觉得愧疚？

lines.en: : I haven’t gotten anything at all. Why? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 我什么都没收到。怎么了？出什么事了？

lines.en: scene utaleak37
: Everybody at school got some...pretty graphic pictures of Uta from when she was back in Nara.
lines.zh: : 学校里每个人都收到了一些……Uta 在奈良时候挺露骨的照片。

lines.en: : ...What?
: I feel really bad. She’s trying to shrug it off like it’s no big deal, but I know it’s getting to her.
lines.zh: : 我心里很不好受。她想装作没什么大不了的，可我知道这伤到她了。

lines.en: : Anyway, that’s really it. Just wanted to keep you in the loop.
lines.zh: : 总之，就是这样。只是想让你知道一下。

lines.en: scene utaleak38
: Maybe give her some space for a little while? Getting involved now would probably just show her that you know something and I don’t want to make her feel even worse than she already does.
lines.zh: : 也许这一阵子先给她点空间？现在掺和进去大概只会让她知道你也听说了，我不想让她比现在更难受。

lines.en: : You...{i}all{/i} got those pictures?
lines.zh: : 你们……{i}全都{/i}收到了那些照片？

lines.en: : Lots of them. She, uhh...
lines.zh: : 好多张。她，呃……

lines.en: : She was pretty {i}active{/i} back in elementary school.
lines.zh: : 她小学的时候可{i}活跃{/i}了。

lines.en: : You really didn’t get anything?
lines.zh: : 你真的一条都没收到？

lines.en: : No...I really didn’t.
lines.zh: : 没有……我真的一条都没收到。

lines.en: : Huh...
